name: room-host
description: A service that stores data-room records. Provisioned as an ordinary integration so that a person can host their own rooms on infrastructure they control (topology T1 of the data-rooms design) without that surface living inside the VTA — the process guarding the master seed must not also terminate presentations from arbitrary DIDs. A room-host holds ciphertext and verifies presentations; it holds no member list and no room keys, so it holds no authority over them. Enrolled with a VTA, it serves as its context's DID and fetches that DID's keys at startup, so its ACL entry is an admin role scoped to that one context (key-export, VTI-VTA-003) — never unscoped. Advertises its rooms/* Trust Task surface as TrustTaskHTTPS (the HTTPS binding's service type: `<URL>/trust-tasks`; a room host is not a VTA, so not VTARest) and DIDComm so a room's own DID can route through the same mediator.
